versions.localizedDescription:
- The Following tab also lists the channels you follow that are offline (most recently live first); open one to see its videos
- Move the chat left or right, full height or into a corner from the player's Chat menu, remembered per channel; the Account tab no longer traps the remote's focus
- Other improvements and fixes
